title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11819)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS IS_11819) covers Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11819). This Indian Standard, which is identical with ISO 7839-1 984 'Textile machinery and accessories — Knitting machines — Classitication and vocabulary', issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ) was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on the recommendation ot the Knrtting Machinery Sectional Committee and approval of the Textile Division Council. Wherever the words 'InternationBi Standard' appear, referring to this standard, they shall be read as Indian Standard'. The French and Russian text of the International Standard and annexe to the standard have been dropped while adopting it In this Indian StandardAdopted 25 March 1 986 © November 1987, BIS | Gr 4 IS : 11819 - 1986 ISO 7839 - 1984

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
